facts.fact: INTIC's chair presented a proposal for a National Strategy for Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity and Data Governance in the context of AI at the 61st FACIM in Maputo, in the week of the 8 September 2026 report.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional de Transformação Digital, de Segurança Cibernética e de Governação de Dados

note: The document names the proposed strategy and its three areas but does not describe its scope or adopting body, so class is left empty.
